Decision.doc: One logged decision. Immutable once written.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: A short name for the decision, the line people will scan.

fields.name: rationale
fields.doc: Why: the context and the alternatives, for whoever asks in six months.

fields.name: supersedes
fields.doc: The decision this one replaces, if any. A claim, checked on read.

DecisionNotes.doc:
What v2 records about a decision beyond v1's `Decision`. Kept in its own
collection so every v1 decision keeps its exact bytes; a decision logged
before v2 simply has none.

fields.name: with
fields.doc:
Accounts the author names as part of the decision. A claim by the
author, shown as such: it does not mean those people signed anything.

fields.name: from_day
fields.doc: The standup day the decision came out of, if it was logged from one.

Help.doc:
One member's offer to help with someone's blocker. The helper is the
owner stamp; the blocked update is named by the entry's key.

fields.name: note
fields.doc: Optional: how they can help. Empty means just "I can help".

MeroStandup.doc: v2. The three v1 collections are carried by name; the rest start empty.

fields.name: updates
fields.doc: Day (`YYYY-MM-DD`) → update, one entry per account per day.

fields.name: decisions
fields.doc: Decision id → decision. Write-once: a record, not a document.

fields.name: profiles
fields.doc: The display name each account chose, in that account's own slot.

fields.name: team
fields.doc: The team's display name. "" until someone names it.

fields.name: helps
fields.doc: `"<day>|<author account>"` → one helper's offer on that update.

fields.name: decision_notes
fields.doc: Decision id → its v2 notes, written once by the decision's author.

Profile.doc:
The display name one account chose for itself.

In the contract rather than only in the browser because everyone ELSE has
to see it. A claim, not an identity: names are not unique, and nothing is
authorised by one.

Update.doc:
One member's standup for one day.

No author and no day field: the author is the entry's owner stamp and the
day is its key. A field could say anything; those two cannot be forged.

fields.name: done
fields.doc: What got done since the last update.

fields.name: blockers
fields.doc: What is in the way. Empty means nothing is.

fields.name: cleared
fields.doc:
Withdrawn by its author. A flag rather than a removal, so the entry
stays the author's and posting again for the same day is an update.
